(333)༄༅/ /zab lam ni gu chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru/ /gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'

tei:div.tei:p: zab lam ni gu chos drug gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so// na mo gu ru// gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs// gsol ba 'debs so bla ma rin po che// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// gnas 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du// chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol=== gsol ba 'debs so sogs tshig rkang gnyis gong gis 'gre'o/ /gnas seng ldeng 'khrigs pa'i nags khrod du// ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu la=== /nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams su// mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la=== /shar mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su// rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus la=== /shar 'od 'phro can gyi zhing khams su// dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen po la=== /shar me tog bkram pa'i zhing khams su// gnyan ston sbas pa'i sangs rgyas la=== /gnas dag pa shar phyogs kyi zhing khams su// 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa la=== /chos rje ston pa'i zhabs drung du// mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston la === /nub pad+mo can gyi zhing khams su// khyung po tshul khrims mgon po la=== /steng dga' ldan lha yi gzhal yas su// bya bral ri khrod ras chen la=== /byang sham+bha la yi pho brang du// shangs dkar ba rin chen rgyal mtshan la=== /lha mi 'khrugs mgon po'i zhing khams su// mnyam med sangs rgyas dpal bzang la=== /rje bla ma gong ma'i ngag zhing dar// grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la=== /zhing me tog pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru la// rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan la=== /gnas phyogs med yangs pa'i rgyal khams su// grol mchog sems kyi mdud grol la=== /gnas brag stod chos kyi pho brang du// chos sku lha dbang grags pa la=== /gnas sman pa'i rgyal po'i zhing khams na// rje btsun tā ra nā tha la=== /gnas pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang na// rje btsun ye shes rgya mtsho la===

/gnas dag pa sprul sku'i zhing khams na// byams pa yon tan mgon po la=== /gnas 'od gsal mkha' spyod zhing khams na// 'ja' (334)lus mgon po dpal 'byor la=== /gnas mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams na// grub mchog mgon po grags pa la=== /gnas bdud rtsi rgyun gyi yang rdzong na// khyab bdag mgon po rnam rgyal la=== /gnas 'o yug phyi gong rdza ra na// rig 'dzin tshe dbang no bu la=== /gnas gcig char mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang na// bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta la=== /gnas rmog lcogs grub pa'i dga' tshal na// kun dga' dge legs dpal 'bar la=== /gnas khyad 'phags gong ma'i gdan sa ru// kun dga' lhun grub rgya mtsho la=== /gnas 'khrul zhig mngon dga'i zhing khams na// grub chen bka' brgyud bstan 'dzin la=== /gnas rang shar longs sku'i pho brang na// mchog gzigs karma lhag mthong la=== /gnas 'khor 'das mnyam nyid dgon pa na// karma gzhan phan 'od zer la=== /gnas kun khyab bde chen 'khor lo na// drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la=== /bka' brgyud phrin las shing rta nas 'di bar gu ṇas gsar 'dzud bgyis pa'o/ /sems dag pa'i 'dun sa nges med du// mched lcam rdo rje spun grogs la=== /gnas rang lus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs la=== /gnas bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du// myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la=== /yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog tu// chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la=== /thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar du byin gyis rlobs// sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol du=== /rmi lam nying 'khrul rang gsal du=== /'od gsal gti mug rang sang du=== /'pho ba ma bsgom sangs rgyas su=== /bar do rgyal ba longs sku ru=== /'od gsal phyag chen rtogs par=== /thabs lam phyin gyi gsol 'debs tshig rkang bdun po sngon gsung rgyun tu mi 'byung yang*/ thang stong lugs kyi gnas sbyar ma las gu ṇas bsab pa'o/// /
